home.faqDescription: Quick answers to the most common questions about Collaby.

faq.question: What is Collaby?
faq.answer: Collaby is a collaboration platform that combines task management, chat, gamification, and analytics in one workspace.

faq.question: Can I register and try it out?
faq.answer: Yes. Create a free account to explore the full platform and all its features.

faq.question: Is Collaby ready for production use?
faq.answer: Collaby is currently in active development. Core features are functional, and we're adding more every month.

faq.question: Which features are already available?
faq.answer: Task boards, projects, user profiles, built-in chat, gamification with leaderboards, and real-time analytics.

faq.question: Is my data secure?
faq.answer: We follow standard security practices. However, as the platform is in early access, we recommend using test data for now.

faq.question: How can I reach the team?
faq.answer: Visit the contacts page or reach out through our public channels on GitHub and Telegram.

about.title: The team and the idea behind Collaby
about.description: Collaby brings task management, communication, gamification, and analytics into one modern workspace. Our mission is to make teamwork clearer, more engaging, and easier to manage.
about.missionDescription: We believe collaboration tools should do more than track tasks — they should make teamwork visible, rewarding, and genuinely productive.
about.visionDescription: Collaby explores how gamification and transparent workflows can make collaboration more understandable and engaging.
about.valuesDescription: The values that guide every decision we make while building Collaby.

values.title: Purpose-driven
values.description: Every feature exists to solve a real collaboration challenge.

values.title: Unified platform
values.description: Tasks, communication, gamification, and analytics belong to one connected system.

values.title: Built together
values.description: Frontend, backend, and product logic are developed as one cohesive effort.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: We ship what works and are honest about what's still in progress.

story: The idea began with a simple observation: most project-management tools track tasks well but rarely make teamwork feel clearer or more engaging.
Instead of building another task tracker, we set out to create a platform where tasks, communication, profiles, analytics, and game mechanics reinforce each other within a single product experience.
Collaby is still evolving. It represents our vision for what modern team collaboration can look like when every piece of the workflow is connected.

quotes.text: I wanted the interface to do more than look good — it should help users think faster, with minimal clicks and maximum clarity.
quotes.author: Temirlan Ospanov

quotes.text: I built the backend so that every module — tasks, chat, gamification — works as one cohesive system, not a collection of separate services.
quotes.author: Dildar Dyusembeyev

quotes.text: We set out to build more than a beautiful interface — we wanted a platform that genuinely helps teams work better together.
quotes.author: Oscar Salnikov
